reason: After exhaustive reasoning, both methods perform identical comparisons: they check for null, then compare year, month, and day components of the two Date objects. The deprecated Date.getYear(), getMonth(), and getDate() methods return the same values that Calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR), get(Calendar.MONTH), and get(Calendar.DATE) would produce for any given Date, because both use the same underlying time value and local time zone. No input can cause one method to return true while the other returns false, nor can one method terminate while the other does not. Therefore, no concrete separating test case exists.
